name: FireDrum Email Marketing
author: FireDrum

sections.description:
Grow your email list directly from your WordPress site. The FireDrum Email Marketing plugin connects your website to your FireDrum account and makes it easy to create, customize, and display opt-in forms — no coding required.

Form Types

  • Inline / Shortcode — embed a signup form anywhere on your site using a shortcode or widget
  • Modal Popup — display a popup triggered immediately, after a delay, on exit intent, or after the visitor scrolls a set percentage of the page
  • Sticky Bar — show a persistent top or bottom bar to capture signups without interrupting the browsing experience

Display & Targeting

  • Show forms everywhere, on the front page, on specific pages, or on WooCommerce pages
  • Cookie-based suppression — control how long before the form shows again after dismissal
  • Trigger options: immediately, after a delay, on exit intent, or after scroll %

Form Builder

  • Choose which standard fields to display: name, address, phone, birthday, anniversary, and more
  • Include custom fields from your FireDrum account
  • Assign forms to one or more contact lists
  • Double opt-in support
  • Anti-spam honeypot
  • Signup notification emails

Styling

  • Match Theme mode — forms automatically inherit your WordPress theme’s styles
  • Custom mode — set button colors, text color, background color, border, font, and size
  • Custom CSS with a form-specific class placeholder
  • Inline or stacked layout mode
  • Hide labels or use placeholder text instead

Live Preview

  • Preview your form directly in the WordPress editor sidebar
  • Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop preview sizes
  • Modal forms preview as a true popup overlay

Integrations

  • WooCommerce — display opt-in forms at checkout and send abandoned cart recovery emails
  • Gravity Forms — sync form submissions to your FireDrum lists
  • Divi / Bloom — connect Bloom opt-in forms to FireDrum
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/firedrum-email-marketing directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Enter your API Key on the FireDrum Setup screen.
  4. You’re Done!
sections.faq:
What is FireDrum?

FireDrum is one of the leading email marketing providers to organizations around the world. FireDrum’s email marketing is easy to use and full of features to help you manage your contacts, campaigns, and track the results using state of the art reporting and analytics.

Still not sure if FireDrum is right for you? Learn more on our website!

What is the cost involved?

This plugin is completely free. Sign up for a FREE account today!
sections.changelog:
1.70

  • Added: Form Styling mode — “Match Theme” (default for new forms) lets the form inherit the WordPress theme’s styles automatically; “Custom” mode enables manual styling controls
  • Added: Added form preview panel in the form editor sidebar
  • Added: Modal form Location options — Home Page and Specific Pages (with page multi-select), in addition to Everywhere
  • Added: “Don’t Show Again For” setting on modal forms — configurable cookie duration in days; set to 0 to show every visit
  • Added: Layout Mode — Inline (email + submit on one row) or Stacked (default)
  • Added: Custom CSS field with {{form_class}} placeholder, gated by Enable Custom CSS checkbox
  • Added: Button Background Color, Button Text Color, and Button Border Radius controls
  • Added: Form Width control
  • Added: Hide Labels toggle
  • Added: Use Placeholders Instead of Labels toggle (automatically hides labels)
  • Added: Customizable Success Message and Error Message fields, pre-filled with defaults
  • Added: “Used On” column on the forms list screen showing which pages each form appears on; Modal and Bar forms show their configured location instead of a shortcode page search
